ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circular plasmid map, with the center labeled pET28a and the size 5367 bp. HindIII (173) is marked above the map, and this figure shows only one cut site for HindIII at this position. Reasoning: The question says that the pET28a plasmid obtained by purified/miniprep is digested by HindIII. The plasmid was originally closed circular and usually exists in a supercoiled form; HindIII has only one recognition cut site on this plasmid map, so cutting once will open the closed circular plasmid into a linear DNA molecule. Therefore, the DNA form changes from supercoiled to linear.

raw_record.question_text: When the purified pET28a plasmid is digested with the restriction enzyme HindIII, how does its DNA form change?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows pET28a as a circular 5367 bp plasmid map, and HindIII is labeled at a single position, 173 bp. From the question text, note that the purified miniprep plasmid is being digested with HindIII. Since the plasmid starts as a circular supercoiled molecule and HindIII has one cut site on the map, digestion opens the circle at that site, changing the DNA form from supercoiled to linear.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个圆形质粒图谱，中心标注为 pET28a，大小为 5367 bp。图谱上方标出了 HindIII (173)，并且该图中只显示 HindIII 在这个位置有一个切点。推理：题目说 purified/miniprep 得到的 pET28a 质粒被 HindIII 消化。质粒原本是闭合环状、通常以超螺旋形式存在；HindIII 在该质粒图谱上只有一个识别切点，因此切开一次会把闭合环状质粒打开成一条线性 DNA 分子。所以 DNA 形式由 supercoiled 变为 linear。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the plasmid is drawn as a circular pET28a map of 5367 bp with HindIII indicated at position 173. The text says the miniprep plasmid was checked on an agarose gel and then will be digested with HindIII. For a plasmid prep, the undigested DNA form is normally supercoiled circular; after complete single-site HindIII digestion, the expected gel product is one linear DNA fragment equal to the plasmid length. Therefore the DNA form changes from supercoiled to linear.
